_meta.description: Optimize photos, videos, and PDFs with intelligent compression. Pick exactly which items to process, watch folders for changes on macOS, throttle network and cloud drives, and reclaim storage on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
_title: Sami - Smart Media Optimizer for Apple Photos, Folders, and Cloud Drives
absolutely-every-task-preview.317d69: Absolutely. Every task preview has a Select mode so you can pick exact items with checkboxes before hitting Run. Sami processes only what you selected — it won't silently pull in newly-matching items between preview and run. Skip selection and Sami processes the full preview set.
absolutely-sami-s-side.8eedb9: Absolutely! Sami's side-by-side comparison feature lets you see exactly how the optimized version will look compared to the original. Inspect details to ensure you're happy with the quality before saving.
adjust-quality-settings-in.8a0492: Adjust quality settings in real-time and see immediate previews. When you're happy with the balance between file size and quality, commit the optimization.
atomic-volume-local-writes.f3a545: Atomic, volume-local writes mean optimizations on external SSDs and network-mounted volumes don't leave partial files or corrupt data, even if something is yanked mid-run.

can-i-choose-which.2f175f: Can I choose which media gets optimized in a task?
can-i-preview-changes.b1fcbe: Can I preview changes before optimizing?
can-i-use-drag.3d9258: Can I use drag and drop to add files?
can-sami-keep-working.14f58a: Can Sami keep working after I close the window?
choose-any-folder-on.57e407: Choose any folder on your device to optimize. Perfect for managing media in Documents, Downloads, or custom locations with full drag-and-drop support.
create-custom-optimization-tasks.d8f638: Create custom optimization tasks that target exactly the media you want. Set filters, quality levels, and output formats for precise control.
create-optimization-tasks-tailored.db16e: Create optimization tasks tailored to your needs. Target specific albums, date ranges, file types, or folders. Set quality levels, output formats, and file size limits for each task.
create-optimization-tasks-with.8365eb: Create optimization tasks with specific targets (albums, folders, date ranges) and quality settings. Tasks can run manually, on a schedule (daily, weekly, monthly), or be triggered from Apple Shortcuts for integration with iOS and macOS automation.
create-photos-library-optimization.d5524: Create Photos Library optimization jobs with all the real settings — media-type filters, age window, minimum file size, quality, and video caps — then list your jobs, check their status, and queue them to run, all from Shortcuts and Siri. Jobs surface in Spotlight too.
does-sami-keep-backups.280071: Does Sami keep backups of original files?
don-t-want-to.5a9cf8: Don't want to wait a week before Sami touches a photo? Pick "No Minimum" and optimize everything that matches your filters, including files you just saved.
enjoy-a-delightful-playful.2522b6: Enjoy a delightful, playful interface that makes media optimization fun. Clear visualizations and smooth animations guide you through every step.
every-task-picks-its.604a28: Every task picks its own backup destination. Different tasks can back up to different drives — external SSD for videos, a NAS for photos, or nothing at all. No more global folder everything has to share.
every-task-preview-lets.1ecf0d: Every task preview lets you enter Select mode and choose exactly which items to run. Sami processes only what you picked — never quietly pulls in newly-matching media behind your back.
flag-any-folder-as.abd20d: Flag any folder as a watched source and Sami re-runs the task automatically whenever files are added or modified, with a configurable debounce so a big import doesn't thrash.
hand-any-images-videos.15ac3f: Hand any images, videos, or PDFs to the new Optimize Media action and they run straight through Sami's real optimizers — using your global settings or any job's preference profile — returning the optimized files for the next step in your shortcut.
how-much-storage-space.412ce8: How much storage space can I save?
integrate-with-apple-shortcuts.a38f7d: Integrate with Apple Shortcuts for powerful automation. Optimize photos when you arrive home, before cloud backups, or based on available storage. The possibilities are endless.
intelligent-media-compression-with.f172f: Intelligent media compression with complete control and transparency
is-the-compression-lossy.c912bd: Is the compression lossy? Will I lose quality?
low-normal-maximum-cpu.ff68ef: Low / Normal / Maximum CPU throttling plus a configurable concurrency cap. Low mode runs Sami at reduced process priority with longer pauses between files so your foreground apps stay responsive — great for daytime batches.
media-optimization-doesn-t.93a3a8: Media optimization doesn't have to be boring. Sami features a delightfully fun UI with smooth animations, clear visualizations, and intuitive controls that make managing your media library enjoyable.
native-interfaces-tailored-to.1bbc42: Native interfaces tailored to each platform mean you get the complete experience no matter which device you're using.
never-guess-about-quality.fd9995: Never guess about quality. See exactly how your optimized media will look with side-by-side comparisons. Inspect details before saving. Your photos, your control.
no-sami-detects-when.a74263: No. Sami detects when a folder is on a network volume, SMB share, or File Provider extension (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Box, etc.) and throttles both reads and backup writes — chunked transfers with short pauses between chunks — so your link stays usable for everything else. Local internal SSDs still run at full speed. You can adjust the network concurrency cap per task.
not-just-for-photos.b52fe5: Not just for photos and videos—Sami optimizes PDFs too. Reduce file sizes of documents while maintaining readability and compatibility.
on-macos-sami-lives.b21ecb: On macOS, Sami lives in the menu bar with a pulsing shark icon while a task is running. Pause, resume, or cancel right from the popover. Hide the Dock icon for an invisible background helper if you prefer.
on-macos-you-can.675c2a: On macOS, you can flag a local folder task as "watched." Sami monitors the folder (and subfolders) for added or modified files using macOS file system events, with a debounce you can tune per-task so a large import doesn't trigger back-to-back runs. When changes settle, Sami runs the task automatically. iOS doesn't allow background watchers on arbitrary folders, so this feature is macOS-only.
one-app-for-iphone.ae2ca7: One app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Watched folders and menu-bar presence are macOS-only where they fit the lifecycle; everything else works everywhere.
optimize-media-directly-from.1c708f: Optimize media directly from your Apple Photos library. Select albums, smart albums, or individual photos and videos to compress and save space.
perfect-for-archiving-optimize.6b85f8: Perfect for archiving. Optimize media you may not need at full quality but want to keep for reference, freeing up space without losing memories.
preview-optimizations-before-committ.7cc: Preview optimizations before committing. Compare original and compressed versions side-by-side to ensure quality meets your standards.
ready-for-ios-27.4543d0: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27
reclaim-storage-across-your.4ef0e0: Reclaim storage across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac with intelligent media optimization. Pick exactly which photos, videos, and PDFs to compress; let Sami watch folders for changes on macOS; and process cloud-hosted media on iCloud Drive or third-party File Provider extensions without saturating your network link.
run-tasks-manually-schedule.479a21: Run tasks manually, schedule them to run automatically, or trigger them from Apple Shortcuts. Perfect for maintaining a lean photo library without constant manual management.
run-your-whole-optimization.68d38a: Run your whole optimization workflow from Shortcuts
sami-can-optimize-photos.f39cfa: Sami can optimize photos (JPEG, PNG, HEIC), videos (MP4, MOV, and more), and PDF documents. It works with media from your Apple Photos library or any folder you choose on your device.
sami-can-optionally-keep.4a7193: Sami can optionally keep reference versions depending on your settings, but you should always maintain your own backups of important media before optimization. The compression is permanent, so backing up originals elsewhere is recommended for files you may want at full quality in the future.
sami-detects-when-a.3be7ed: Sami detects when a folder lives on a NAS, SMB share, or cloud drive and throttles reads and backup writes so your link never saturates. Local SSDs still run at full speed.
sami-is-a-universal.1935f6: Sami is a universal app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. One purchase works across all your devices with full feature parity.
sami-materializes-dataless-file.84e3bd: Sami materializes dataless File Provider items before reading them, using the system's download coordination APIs. After a successful optimization it can evict the local cached copy on iCloud Drive so your disk stays clean (best-effort on third-party providers, which don't all expose the same eviction surface).
sami-pauses-automatically-in.d797d1: Sami pauses automatically in Low Power Mode, on battery, on metered networks, or in Low Data Mode — each gate is an independent toggle. Folder tasks over a hotspot or a NAS with a capped plan just stop until conditions change.
sami-uses-lossy-compression.058ed9: Sami uses lossy compression to achieve significant space savings. This means there will be some quality loss in the optimized media. The side-by-side preview lets you evaluate if the quality trade-off is acceptable for your needs. Always keep backups of important media before optimization.
savings-vary-based-on.f59b53: Savings vary based on your media and chosen quality settings, but typically range from 30-70% for photos and videos. Sami provides estimated savings before you optimize, so you know exactly what to expect. PDFs can often be reduced by 50% or more depending on their content.
schedule-tasks-to-run.702898: Schedule tasks to run automatically in the background. Trigger optimizations from Apple Shortcuts or set up recurring schedules to keep storage under control.
see-exactly-how-much.55530b: See exactly how much storage space you'll save before running any optimization. Make informed decisions about quality vs. storage trade-offs.
set-it-and-forget.bfae9c: Set it and forget it. Configure tasks to run on a schedule—daily, weekly, or monthly. Sami works quietly in the background, keeping your storage optimized without you thinking about it.
simply-drag-media-files.7ab96f: Simply drag media files into Sami to optimize them. Quick, intuitive file handling makes batch processing a breeze on Mac and iPad.
smart-media-optimizer-for.b515fa: Smart Media Optimizer for Photos, Folders, and the Cloud
take-a-closer-look.72cc29: Take a closer look at Sami in action
trigger-optimizations-from-shortcuts.241: Trigger optimizations from Shortcuts automations. Integrate Sami into your workflows—optimize photos when you get home, before backups, or on demand.
watch-successes-skips-and.65c5c7: Watch successes, skips, and failures scroll by in real time as a run progresses — with the reason next to each item — so you can spot patterns without waiting for the summary.
watch-your-storage-savings.7d360f: Watch your storage savings grow with satisfying progress indicators. See estimated space savings update in real-time as you adjust quality settings. Every interaction feels responsive and polished.
what-about-icloud-drive.cbbae2: What about iCloud Drive and other cloud files that aren't downloaded?
what-types-of-media.42b195: What types of media can Sami optimize?
will-sami-saturate-my.c9dc22: Will Sami saturate my network when I point it at a NAS or cloud drive?
will-sami-work-on.7a6955: Will Sami work on all my Apple devices?
works-with-dataless-files.d8877e: Works with dataless files from iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Box, and other File Provider extensions. Sami materializes items before read and can evict the local cache after a successful run.
yes-on-mac-and.5c6090: Yes! On Mac and iPad, you can drag and drop media files directly into Sami to optimize them quickly. This makes batch processing large numbers of files fast and intuitive.
yes-on-macos-enable.096678: Yes, on macOS. Enable "Keep running when window is closed" in Settings and Sami stays alive so watched folders and scheduled automations keep firing. You can independently control whether Sami appears in the Dock, the menu bar, both, or neither — opt into fully invisible background execution if that's your preference. Relaunching from Finder/Spotlight reactivates the running process and brings the window back.
yes-sami-is-a.dcce95: Yes! Sami is a universal app that works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with full feature parity. Purchase once and use it across all your Apple devices.
yes-sami-uses-lossy.64f3d5: Yes, Sami uses lossy compression to achieve significant space savings. There will be some quality loss, but the side-by-side preview feature lets you evaluate the quality trade-off before committing. You have full control over compression levels to balance quality vs. file size based on your needs.
